snippet.title: Infrastructure Split: SMCI Surged as GEV Sank
snippet.description:
Super Micro Computer surged 19.84% while the Nasdaq 100 fell 0.54%. GE Vernova dropped 8.69% while the Industrial Select Sector SPDR ETF finished up 0.11%. The July 22 close priced two company-specific reactions inside one infrastructure theme.

This post-close breakdown walks SMCI's 28.50–32.2844 decision range, the Nasdaq 100 control at 29,176.9139, GEV's 985.03 close and 1,038.985 recovery test, plus the S&P 500 and VIX confirmation.

Primary sources:
Supermicro investor relations: https://ir.supermicro.com/news/news-details/2026/Supermicro-Provides-Fourth-Quarter-of-Fiscal-Year-2026-Preliminary-Business-Update/default.aspx
GE Vernova investor relations: https://www.gevernova.com/news/press-releases/ge-vernova-reports-second-quarter-2026-financial-results-raises-2026-financial
Charts: TradingView settled daily bars for July 22, 2026.
